program: Wingless repaired-bridge 2x2 suppression factorial under fixed future-data budget
question: For the R5 selected code-target queries containing raw class-5/6 motifs, is suppression primarily caused by the low-support fallback branch, the exact-context branch, their interaction, or neither?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R5/R4 training sources, 15,819-byte training budget, 256 motifs, 8x32 classes, 1,454-byte code target, selected-query criterion, relation/exact tables, row eligibility, margins, and depth-3 cap. Add a diagnostic-only 2x2 bridge evaluator with two frozen binary factors: L=enable the low-support (<3 pair-count) fallback mixture; E=enable exact-context replacement for dedicated eligible low-margin pairs. Evaluate B00 (L0,E0), B10 (L1,E0), B01 (L0,E1), and B11 (L1,E1, byte-identical full R5 repair). For each selected query, compare the best rank of raw-focus classes 5/6 against B00 and classify exactly one frozen effect category: low_support_main if only B10 worsens; exact_context_main if only B01 worsens; additive_shared if both B10 and B01 worsen; interaction_only if neither single factor worsens but B11 does; full_no_suppression if B11 does not worsen; unresolved if accounting cannot assign exactly one category. No representation, capacity, data, thresholds, or final production bridge changes occur.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; optimize transfer-efficient learning, not self-modification

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Repair-selection suppression dominates the stage attribution; factorial separation is required before proposing any bridge change.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

factorial.B11: low_support_fallback=true, exact_context=true; must be byte-identical full R5 repair
factorial.suppression_test: best rank of a raw-focus class-5/6 member is worse than B00 and greater than 1

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; all 21 selected queries receive exactly one frozen factorial category; B11 reproduces R5 exactly; and at least one of low_support_main, exact_context_main, additive_shared, or interaction_only occurs.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes and B11 reproduces R5, but every selected query is full_no_suppression despite R5's stage attribution.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, selected-query identity, bridge-factor identity, B11 identity, accounting, determinism, provenance, or qualification criterion fails.

successor_if_low_support_main_dominates.intent: test a bounded low-support fallback alternative against no-change under the same fixed data/compute/capacity budget, with later disjoint transfer required before retention

successor_if_exact_or_interaction_domina.intent: attribute the exact-context or interaction mechanism further before proposing any bounded change

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter source identities, budgets, 256 capacity, 8x32 classes, selected-query set, factor definitions, suppression test, categories, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
